featured_reviews.name: AJAY GIANCHANDANI
featured_reviews.review_text: Had a stay at Mumbai House Luxury Apartments Santa Cruz. The 1 BHK apartment was neat and clean way beyond my expectations. The Manager and staff were polite and courteous. Walkable distance from Santa Cruz Station East and very near the Western Express Highway. I fail to understand certain negative reviews of the hotel. Value for money, neat and clean, near railway station. What more you can expect. You are getting a spacious 500 sq feet 1bhk apartment at the price at which you would get a single 150 sq feet room. Would definitely recommend to anyone looking for hourly stays or overnight stays.

featured_reviews.name: Anup D'Souza
featured_reviews.review_text: The place is located close to Santacruz station but is on the inroads. While the accomodation itself is fine, the biggest and most concerning issue was the presence of cockroaches. Every room had them in some number but the kitchen and living room we're riddled with them. So much so that even sitting on the sofa outside would cause them to come out. We couldn't even leave bags high up on the table because cockroaches of all sizes would end up on them. So forget about leaving any eatables exposed. I think the reason is poor pest control and since they do not provide room service, you are at the mercy of previous guests who may or may not have maintained enough hygiene so as to keep the roach population suppressed. The staff are polite and helpful but there isn't much they can do in this regard. We ended up having all our meals outside and avoided ordering food to the room altogether. Very disappointed with the stay here especially since we've stayed at Mumbai House Andheri before and the experience was quite the opposite. Having a child along compounded the issue as they couldn't move freely between rooms for fear of running into the cockroaches. Definitely not worth the money paid for the rooms and I wish that I could've gotten my money back. The only good thing is the view that lets you watch flights take off every few mins due to its proximity to the airport. Would not recommend until they've got rid of the roaches.

The approach to the building was intimidating, with large crowds lingering in the narrow lanes and constant noise throughout the night. We did not feel secure stepping outside, even during the day. This is absolutely not a location suitable for travelers unfamiliar with the area or anyone prioritizing safety and peace of mind.

The listing photos were completely misleading and gave no indication of the surrounding environment. Had we known the actual condition of the location, we would never have booked this place.

I strongly urge Airbnb to reassess whether this listing should even be on the platform, and I hope other travelers—especially women—are spared this stressful experience.

featured_reviews.name: Abhilasha Jain
featured_reviews.review_text:
Review for Rustamjee Seasons, BKC

If you’re planning to rent or buy here, I’d strongly say: think twice.

The building looks great on the surface with every amenity listed—gym, pool, squash, TT, yoga rooms—but in practice, it’s a disappointment . Here’s why:
1.	Rigid and impractical rules:
•	Table tennis and squash are restricted with sudden, unclear rules—you can’t just go and play when you want.
•	Gym timings are extremely rigid. Management insists the gym cannot open early because the trainer isn’t available, but ironically, the trainer often shows up an hour late even after the gym has officially opened. Makes no sense.
2.	Amenities without basics:
•	The pool is there, but essential float boards or safety equipment are missing. It’s incomplete and not child-friendly.
3.	Hidden charges everywhere:
•	Even after paying steep rents, almost everything is chargeable—yoga rooms, certain common spaces, and more. Feels unfair and exploitative considering the rent is already high.

On top of this, the hygiene is terrible (toilets stink worse than public ones), lifts are painfully slow, and the management is neither flexible nor approachable. If you’re a tenant, your say is practically zero. Even flat owners don’t have much control since the committee runs on its own agenda. And yes parking is scary-no space to even get into the car-forget your car even being cleaned . I think the list is never ending!

Yes, it’s one of the few residential complexes in BKC, but amenities you can’t use and management you can’t reason with cancel out any advantage.

Verdict: Not worth the rent, not worth the stress. Big no from my side.
